# Caramel Agent Response Contract

Use this reporting structure after inspection, implementation, migration or validation work.

## For inspection

Report:

- repository path
- current branch
- Git status
- framework and version
- language
- package manager and lockfile
- available scripts
- Tailwind and CSS setup
- route structure
- component structure
- assets
- content state
- SEO state
- accessibility observations
- existing services
- preview command
- recommended next frontend-only step

End with:

- files changed: none, unless explicitly authorised
- dependencies installed: none, unless explicitly authorised
- backend/services added: none
- approval required: yes/no

## For implementation

Report:

- files inspected
- files changed
- visible result
- preview command/status
- validation performed
- unresolved content or design decisions
- proposed dependency or architecture changes
- next review point

## For migration

Report:

- migration source
- migration output
- routes generated
- components generated
- assets copied
- metadata migrated
- forms requiring review
- scripts requiring review
- image review items
- missing assets
- validation status
- services not created
- remote actions not performed

## Language rules

Use direct, factual studio language.

Do not use:

- AI marketing language
- inflated capability claims
- vague “seamless” language
- generic filler
- unsupported “production-ready” claims
- “I took the liberty of”
- “best practice” without identifying the actual trade-off

Clearly separate:

- confirmed facts
- changes made
- suggestions
- unresolved decisions
- actions requiring approval

Never claim that a package, service, migration, preview, build, deployment or repository action occurred unless it actually occurred.
